## History

Stella Maynard, who was poor, obtained a good all-round showing in her examinations. She went on to live at Patty's Place with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), where they learned they could stay for an additional year. During their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cheered themselves up on a rainy evening by reading old, overly tragic stories from Anne's childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club). After completing examinations and graduating, Stella and her housemates reflected on their college experiences as they packed up Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v3 ch.Confidences P14](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0014), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), +11 more_

## Quotes

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "I begin to feel that life is worth living as long as there’s a laugh in it."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P40](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends whose bond originated during their time together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They later live together at Patty's Place along with their other housemates, sharing college life, home routines, and preparing for examinations. During their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), the two spend cozy evenings cheering themselves up by reading overly tragic stories written during Anne's childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +18 more_

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) are close friends who first became chums at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They continue their close companionship into their university years as housemates residing together at Patty's Place alongside their fellow students. Together with their housemates, they navigate college studies, shared living arrangements, and the events leading up to their final graduation from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +18 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella maintains a friendly correspondence with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), exchanging letters and personal confidences.
